mechanism.notes: the lead roller-longdyad-knuckle-3r with the MR63ZZ flank roller deleted: the crank's bent long arm ends in a pressed ISO 8734 m6 440C dowel (hardened, polished; O3 at nose_r 1.5, O2 at nose_r 1.0) that slides on the conjugate flank wire-EDM'd into link 1a's boss (a-C:H DLC, greased). -1 moving body (roller), -1 passive rotation, -1 joint, rolling pairs 2 -> 1 (lobe-follower), sliding pairs 0 -> 1 (nose-flank); catalogue 15 -1 (MR63ZZ) +1 (dowel) = 15 (the spec's 22.0 left the dowel out; with it 22.25). Pin knee as the lead (unsensed, 0 by the v2 rule).
